title: Please help me identify this French Movie

commenti.body: Your description reminds me a lot of "The River" (La Rivière in French, 2001), but the ending differed slightly. The two main characters did indeed love the same girl and the lead character was a swimmer. Perhaps the dramatic scene you remember was a misinterpretation due to the language barrier? Or perhaps there's an alternate ending I am not aware of. Do you remember any more specifics that might help nail it down?

The Big Blue by luc besson! 

Two children, Jacques Mayol and Enzo Molinari, grow up on the Greek island of Amorgos in the 1960s. Enzo challenges Jacques to collect a coin on the sea floor but Jacques refuses. Jacques' father—who harvests shellfish from the seabed using a pump-supplied air hose and helmet—goes diving. His breathing apparatus and rope gets caught and punctured by rocks, and weighed down by water, he drowns in front of Jacques and Enzo.

I suggest you make the same post on r/tipofthetongue, those people out there are wizards. They will 100% be able to identify this movie.
